status: PROPOSED — the coordinator freezes this file; the guard binds it by digest
why_this_form: own_est + opp_est == 2 * projected_team_off_possessions holds EXACTLY on all 2,982 resolved rows,
so {own_est, opp_est} spans the same two dimensions as {offset, own_est - opp_est}.
The symmetric direction IS the offset and carries zero new information.
The antisymmetric direction is the only nonredundant direction the pair contains.
Admitting the CONTRAST instead of the PAIR is therefore not a weakening of the guard:
it is the unique reparameterisation that keeps the offset a constraint rather than a free parameter.

contrasts.name: contrast_own_minus_opp_pace_estimate

input_definitions.opp_est: team_possession_prior_v1.team_pace_estimate on the SAME game_id, other team_id

admissibility_conditions: the column must reproduce the formula EXACTLY (max |deviation| <= 1e-12)
the augmented design [offset | contrast] must be full rank in EVERY chronological fold
R^2(offset ~ 1 + contrast) must be below 0.998001 in EVERY fold
own_est and opp_est must NOT also appear as design columns
